rationale: Bill's work on LLM efficiency and real-time AI perception at General Instinct complements Jinal's data science and ML infrastructure expertise—Bill is building the cutting-edge model layer while Jinal's background in data-driven systems and analytics could inform how to instrument and optimize performance in production. Both operate in the ML space but from different angles: Bill on research-forward model optimization (sparse attention, parameter-efficient fine-tuning) and Jinal on the data and infrastructure side.
intro_message: Bill Jiao, meet Jinal Thakker — Bill is working on LLM efficiency and real-time perception at General Instinct (YC P26), and Jinal's data science and ML infrastructure experience could be a useful sounding board for production optimization challenges.
